restrictions: No network client, credentials, source scanning or mutation capability.
Source-shaped reference fields are not assertions about a vendor API.
Synthetic collection completeness never establishes enterprise coverage.
Neither synthetic policy status nor a ticket state authorizes execution.
Capabilities, package presence and version numbers do not establish cryptographic use.

application-portfolio.name: Application portfolio
candidate_automation: Reconcile portfolio identities and accountable owner routes with CMDB records.
manual_boundary: A business owner determines criticality and approves the assessment boundary.
information_loss: An owner route identifier does not prove a current accountable individual.
unsupported_capabilities: No native portfolio API, application creation or owner acceptance.

certificate-authorities.name: Certificate authorities and trust stores
candidate_automation: Build issuer-to-trust-consumer compatibility cohorts and prepare staged trust distribution.
manual_boundary: CA policy owners authorize issuance policy and relying-party trust changes.
information_loss: A trust-store snapshot does not prove every relying party accepted an anchor.
unsupported_capabilities: No issuance, trust-store write or post-quantum certificate interoperability proof.

hsm.name: Hardware cryptographic modules
candidate_automation: Compare recorded consumer operations with module capability and firmware constraints.
manual_boundary: Custodians authorize ceremonies, firmware changes and non-exportability policy.
information_loss: Supported mechanisms do not identify active consumers or prove validated module status.
unsupported_capabilities: No private key extraction, HSM login, ceremony execution or certification claim.

api-and-mesh.name: API gateways and service meshes
candidate_automation: Prepare route-specific TLS canaries and independently compare configured and negotiated behavior.
manual_boundary: Platform owners approve route scope, canaries and recovery windows.
information_loss: A gateway route does not enumerate every client or downstream hop.
unsupported_capabilities: No mesh control-plane connection, route write or negotiated PQC proof.

network-telemetry.name: Network observation platforms
candidate_automation: Correlate handshake observations with endpoint declarations and record blind spots.
manual_boundary: Network and privacy owners approve observation boundaries and retained metadata.
information_loss: A sensor sample cannot establish all traffic or client coverage.
unsupported_capabilities: No packet capture, active scanning, payload retention or production sensor integration.

ssh.name: SSH and machine administration
candidate_automation: Build client/server compatibility cohorts and test approved hybrid key-exchange canaries.
manual_boundary: Access owners approve host-key trust and recovery access before any change.
information_loss: Hybrid key exchange does not establish post-quantum host or user signatures.
unsupported_capabilities: No host SSH access, account edits, daemon configuration or remote execution.

vpn.name: VPN and encrypted network access
candidate_automation: Compare peer compatibility and propose bounded tunnel upgrade cohorts.
manual_boundary: Remote access owners approve outage tolerance and alternative access routes.
information_loss: Gateway metadata does not prove every peer negotiation or tunnel health.
unsupported_capabilities: No tunnel reconfiguration, vendor hybrid capability assertion or live peer test.

source-build.name: Source repositories and build pipelines
candidate_automation: Prepare reviewed dependency and call-site changes with before/after application tests.
manual_boundary: Maintainers approve source changes, compatibility policy and deployment.
information_loss: A build result or runtime version does not prove deployed cryptographic behavior.
unsupported_capabilities: No repository cloning, hosted pull request, build execution or deployment.

dependency-analysis.name: Software component and code analysis
candidate_automation: Join dependency provenance and actual cryptographic call sites to migration candidates.
manual_boundary: Maintainers resolve static-analysis ambiguity and approve library/API changes.
information_loss: Package presence and declared capability never establish active cryptographic use.
unsupported_capabilities: No SAST/SCA tool API, SBOM completeness proof, repository scan or automatic patch.

software-signing.name: Artifact signing and distribution
candidate_automation: Stage signer/verifier compatibility policies and test legacy artifact verification.
manual_boundary: Release owners approve verifier rollout, trust changes and release signing.
information_loss: A signature record does not prove every distribution consumer can verify it.
unsupported_capabilities: No artifact signing, distribution write, trust enrollment or private key retrieval.

cloud-inventory.name: Cloud workloads and runtime inventory
candidate_automation: Reconcile deployed versions and managed-service dependencies into application cohorts.
manual_boundary: Platform owners authorize cloud tenancy, deployment route and managed-service choices.
information_loss: Resource presence does not establish encryption use or customer control over algorithms.
unsupported_capabilities: No cloud account API, workload enumeration, managed-service update or deployment.

kms.name: Key management services
candidate_automation: Model envelope key consumers and assess rewrapping versus data re-encryption.
manual_boundary: Key and data owners approve key policy, rotation and recovery requirements.
information_loss: A key identifier and capability list do not prove a consumer operation or recoverability.
unsupported_capabilities: No key retrieval, generation, wrapping operation, deletion or policy mutation.

secrets.name: Secrets and credential management
candidate_automation: Map credential metadata and consumers into staged rotation/issuer compatibility plans.
manual_boundary: Identity owners authorize credential lifecycle and outage/recovery policy.
information_loss: A credential reference contains no secret value and does not prove actual consumer use.
unsupported_capabilities: No secret, password, token or private key read; no issuance or rotation.

iam.name: Identity and federation
candidate_automation: Map issuer and relying-party verification compatibility before token-signing changes.
manual_boundary: Identity authorities approve trust, token policy and fallback behavior.
information_loss: Issuer configuration does not prove all relying parties or acceptance policies.
unsupported_capabilities: No token acquisition, account access, federation change or sign-in attempt.

databases.name: Databases and data platforms
candidate_automation: Join storage encryption, wrapping key, client and confidentiality-lifetime dependencies.
manual_boundary: Database and data owners approve change windows and recovery testing.
information_loss: Symmetric data encryption must not be equated with classical public-key exposure.
unsupported_capabilities: No database connection, query execution, encryption change or production backup.

storage-backup.name: Storage, archives and backup
candidate_automation: Model long-lived archives and generate restoration-dependent migration/recovery plans.
manual_boundary: Data owners approve retention, restoration acceptance and irreversible re-encryption.
information_loss: A backup record does not prove restore success or retained key availability.
unsupported_capabilities: No backup export, data read, key retrieval, deletion or restore execution.

data-governance.name: Data classification and lifecycle
candidate_automation: Join information lifetimes to cryptographic uses and raise missing-owner/lifetime actions.
manual_boundary: Data owners determine classification and required confidentiality/integrity lifetime.
information_loss: Synthetic proposed classifications are not enterprise data-owner acceptance.
unsupported_capabilities: No data-content scan, sensitive sample retention or automatic classification acceptance.

communications.name: DNS, email and document platforms
candidate_automation: Build distinct DNS, mail and document verification cohorts and identify long-lived signed-content constraints.
manual_boundary: Communications and records owners approve trust/format migration and external interoperability.
information_loss: Distinct signature examples still do not model every DNSSEC algorithm, email encryption path or document validation format.
unsupported_capabilities: No mailbox/document content access, DNS change, sending or external delivery.

endpoints.name: Endpoint and mobile fleet management
candidate_automation: Build device compatibility cohorts and plan staged trust/verifier updates.
manual_boundary: Fleet owners authorize rollout, outage handling and user-impact acceptance.
information_loss: An endpoint inventory snapshot does not prove current online state or user access.
unsupported_capabilities: No device connection, MDM policy write, software push or remote wipe.

embedded-ot.name: Embedded, firmware and operational systems
candidate_automation: Track firmware trust constraints and prepare vendor-dependent update qualification plans.
manual_boundary: Safety and specialist operators authorize maintenance and recovery procedures.
information_loss: Vendor-reported verification behavior has not been independently reproduced.
unsupported_capabilities: No device probe, firmware flash, control-system action or safety certification.

specialized-transactions.name: Payment and transaction cryptography
candidate_automation: Assemble specialist dependency, vendor and ceremony review packets.
manual_boundary: Domain experts retain dual control, regulatory interpretation and ceremony authority.
information_loss: A reference transaction signature does not model all payment cryptography or mandates.
unsupported_capabilities: No payment messages, financial records, transaction execution or key ceremony.

mainframe.name: Mainframe cryptographic services
candidate_automation: Map cryptographic service consumers and module/vendor upgrade constraints.
manual_boundary: Mainframe security and platform specialists approve service and custody changes.
information_loss: Mechanism support alone does not identify consumer use or hardware qualification.
unsupported_capabilities: No mainframe connection, job submission, key retrieval or module upgrade.

policy-exceptions.name: Policy, exceptions and work coordination
candidate_automation: Prepare evidence-linked exception reviews and provider-neutral work item drafts.
manual_boundary: Designated humans decide policy authority, limitations and exact-plan approvals.
information_loss: A source-reported approved review state and external ticket closure never grant canonical exact-plan authorization.
unsupported_capabilities: No approval creation, acceptance assertion, ticket mutation or policy enforcement.

vendor-assurance.name: Vendor assurance and detection
candidate_automation: Track version-bound vendor claims, qualification gaps and expiring support statements.
manual_boundary: Product owners and assurance functions accept vendor evidence and residual uncertainty.
information_loss: A vendor roadmap, capability statement or reported verified state is neither deployment nor independently established verification evidence.
unsupported_capabilities: No vendor portal login, assurance certification or claim of installed product support.
